title: Exceptional cyclotomic cardinality bound for complete permutation exponents
summary: Determine whether the exceptional cyclotomic subset in the Wu--Feng--Li--Helleseth construction always has cardinality below $p^t-2$.

formal_statement.body: Under the source hypotheses, let $r+1$ be an odd prime with $p^{r/2}\equiv-1\pmod{r+1}$, let $p^r=k(r+1)+1$, let $t$ be an odd prime with $\gcd(t,r)=1$, let $\gcd(m,r+1)=1$, $1\le l\le r$, and assume $ktlm\equiv-2\pmod{r+1}$. For the source cyclotomic subset $C_{-(lm)^{-1}}\subseteq\mathbb F_{p^t}^{*}\setminus\{-1\}$, prove $|C_{-(lm)^{-1}}|<p^t-2$ for every admissible tuple, equivalently prove the source irreducible-polynomial formulation, or give a counterexample.

scope.domain: Cyclotomic subsets and irreducible-polynomial criteria underlying m-sequence cross-correlation
assumptions: All prime, congruence, coprimality, and range conditions stated in the source Conjectures 2 and 3 hold
The set $C_i$ uses the source definition
scope.unresolved_remainder: No inspected later primary result settles the strict cardinality bound over the full exceptional-congruence parameter family or its equivalent irreducible-polynomial existence statement.

progress.summary: Computer experiments lead to Conjecture 2, and the source states an equivalent irreducible-polynomial Conjecture 3.
